domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare fractions for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite fraction or mixed-number parts into a subtraction-ready form by creating a common denominator and/or converting a whole or nonstandard mixed number into standard component form.
skills.merge_rationale: S01 and S02 are both preparatory representation skills used before core subtraction. They differ in surface form, but both serve the same phase of work: making the expression subtraction-ready. In the dossiers, these steps often function as setup rather than diagnostically distinct execution errors.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts once they are in a compatible form, typically by subtracting numerators over a shared denominator.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because fraction-part subtraction is a core execution skill with distinct error patterns from setup, whole-part subtraction, borrowing, and simplification.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Compute the difference of whole-number components in mixed-number or whole-number subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because whole-part subtraction is diagnostically distinct from fraction subtraction; students may succeed on one component and fail on the other.

skills.name: Regroup across a mixed number
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is insufficient for subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because borrowing/regrouping is a high-value diagnostic skill with characteristic errors and is not always required.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and state the final answer in an appropriate form such as a fraction, mixed number, integer, or 0.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final simplification and expression are post-processing skills with distinct mistakes from subtraction itself.
